name: How long does it take to install a wheelchair accessible vanity?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a wheelchair accessible vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for a wheelchair accessible vanity typically depends on the current bathroom configuration and the extent of modifications required. A straightforward replacement with minor plumbing adjustments might take 1-2 days. However, if the project involves reconfiguring water lines, relocating drainpipes, or making structural changes to accommodate the new vanity, the process could extend to 3-5 days or longer. We will provide a project timeline during your initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation usually takes 1-2 days for simple replacements, but can extend to 3-5 days or more if major plumbing or structural changes are needed.
